title: seams project manifest
description: The tracked .agents/seams.json manifest for a project that uses seams.

$schema.description: URL of the published schema for editor support.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the manifest schema. Controls parsing and migrations.

seamsVersion.description: Package version that last intentionally initialized or migrated the manifest.

paths.description: Documentation homes, relative to the repository root.

lastReconciledRevision.description: Revision recorded by the last completed reconciliation action.

relativePath.description: A relative path inside the repository: no leading slash, no drive letter, no `..` segment, no backslashes.
